storage_policies.name: Customers upload own payment receipts
storage_policies.check:
((bucket_id = 'payment-receipts'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE (((b.id)::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[2]) AND (b.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (b.status = 'pending_payment'::text) AND (b.expires_at > now())))))

storage_policies.name: Owners and admins delete event covers
storage_policies.using: ((bucket_id = 'event-covers'::text) AND (( SELECT private.current_profile_role() AS current_profile_role) = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text))
